title: Dark mode: the part window pill, other-locations hints, Cancel label and title/footer lines read correctly
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-B1 (active, stocked at both locations); QAPL-I2 (inactive). Theme: profile menu > Dark (Cancel dark-mode fix from comment 79872 is on sv10647).
custom_steps:
1. Profile menu > Dark. Parts > Inventory (Active tab) > open QAPL-B1.
  2. Change the Description and the Part Number without saving.
  3. Look at the footer buttons.
  4. Click Cancel, then reopen QAPL-B1.
  5. Inventory > Inactive tab > open QAPL-I2.
  6. Profile menu > Light > open QAPL-B1.
custom_expected:
1. pill_part_status shows a green "Active" beside the X, legible; the thin line under the title row and the one above the footer are visible.
  2. "This also changes the description at 1 other location." and "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." show in the warning colour, legible on the dark background.
  3. Cancel has a light label and outline and reads as enabled (about 11:1 contrast, not the old grey-8 at about 2.4:1); Delete Part is red with a white trash icon and label; Save is blue with a white label.
  4. The dialog closes without saving; the reopened dialog shows the saved values.
  5. The grey "Inactive" pill is legible beside the X.
  6. Light mode is unchanged: Cancel white with a grey outline and dark label, green "Active" pill, both thin lines.
